routing_recommendation.rationale: To satisfy both the 'futuristic star map' (smooth curves) and the 'internal twin routing' (orthogonal avoidance), you must decouple the *pathfinding* from the *rendering*. Use an orthogonal grid-based routing algorithm (like A* or Lee) to navigate around membrane bounding boxes (ensuring zero overlap and matching the internal logic). Then, apply a massive corner radius (e.g., 64px to 128px) to the orthogonal path before rendering. This mathematically transforms rigid 90-degree zig-zags into sweeping, organic, spline-like space-lanes that never clip through territories.

visual_parameters.anchoring: Perpendicular to the closest edge of the concave membrane boundary. Use intersection math on the SVG/Canvas path to stop the line exactly on the stroke of the membrane.
visual_parameters.obstacle_padding: Minimum 48px clearance (buffer zone) around any domain membrane to create 'breathing room' and visual tension.
visual_parameters.corner_radius: 64px to 128px (relative to map scale) for macro corridors to create the 'stellar curve' illusion.
visual_parameters.corridor_hover: stroke: #25D0C8, opacity: 0.8, stroke-width: 2px, filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(37,208,200,0.8)); transition: all 0.3s ease.
visual_parameters.corridor_active: stroke: #25D0C8, opacity: 1.0, stroke-width: 2px, stroke-dasharray: 4 8, animated stroke-dashoffset for data flow.

fonts.headings: Rajdhani (for HUD macro numbers, domain titles, and spatial coordinates)
fonts.body: Manrope (for descriptions, tooltips, and readable UI panels)
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono (for node IDs, metrics, active data streams, and technical specs)

rules.tracking: Use tracking-tight for Rajdhani headings. Use tracking-[0.2em] uppercase for overlines/labels.
rules.hierarchy: H1 max text-5xl, H2 text-3xl. Do not oversize text; maintain the precision of a high-tech instrument.

colors.archetype: Electric & Neon (Context: Futuristic HUD & Spatial Canvas)

rules.contrast: Ensure all cyan text on the dark canvas passes APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Never use pure black or pure white.
rules.interactive: Hover states must increase luminosity and add subtle box-shadow glows. No generic Vercel-style flat gray hovers.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant) for UI panels floating over the canvas. bg-[#0F1D28]/70 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-t border-[#25D0C8]/20.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle deep-space grid (opacity 0.03, #25D0C8) mapped to the canvas background to give spatial reference.
visual_enhancers.hud_elements: Use sharp 1px borders with 2px inner glows for selected nodes. Include crosshairs or corner-brackets (L-shapes) for domain bounding boxes.

grids.ui_overlay: Bento-style floating panels around the perimeter of the screen, leaving the center 70% entirely for the Atlas canvas.

layouts.structure: 100vw x 100vh overarching container overflow-hidden. Absolute positioned UI layer (z-50) + Interactive Canvas layer (z-10).
layouts.panels: Generous internal padding (p-6) for floating detail panels. Use optical alignment.

motion.zoom: Smooth semantic zoom interpolation. Fade out macro elements (domains) and fade in micro elements (twins/robots) over a 20% scale threshold to prevent visual popping.
motion.corridors: Animate dash-arrays on active corridors. Use framer-motion for smooth path drawing (draw-in effect) on initial load.
motion.hover: Scale active nodes/stars by 1.1x with a spring physics transition (stiffness: 300, damping: 20).

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (zoom controls, domain nodes, twin nodes, panels) MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='domain-node-auth').
accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Corridors must be distinguishable from the background.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable path dash animations and use instant zoom if true.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (for precise, geometric tech look) or Lucide-react.
media.images: N/A - System relies on generative/rendered spatial canvas nodes rather than static images.

3d_libraries.recommendation: If rendering via DOM/SVG becomes a bottleneck with >500 nodes, transition to React Flow (2D) or Visx. If genuine 3D space is desired, use React Force Graph (2D/3D modes) or React Three Fiber with Drei for high-performance WebGL rendering.

instructions_to_main_agent.routing_implementation: Implement orthogonal pathfinding for corridors. After calculating the orthogonal points, map over them and use an SVG arc/bezier generator or a library like 'd3-path' or standard canvas arcTo() to round the 90-degree corners with a 64px+ radius. Do NOT draw direct straight lines between domains.
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_layer: Build the overlay UI using Shadcn components customized with the dark futuristic theme (remove standard radii, apply HUD styles, borders, and backdrop blurs).
instructions_to_main_agent.canvas_layer: Ensure the Atlas canvas is built to handle pan/zoom (via d3-zoom or react-zoom-pan-pinch) and properly distinct from the fixed UI layer.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles (e.g., sharp corners for this HUD theme) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable in the UI panels. Cramped designs look cheap.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
